note: _habitabant in terra Juda_ (Clementina) _–_ they dwelt in the land of Judah. Weber/Gryson has _in terra Iudaeae_.

_in ieiuniis et orationibus_ (Clementina) – in fastings and prayers. The Weber/Gryson edition omits _et orationibus_, words imported from Judith 4:12. –Thielmann: _Beiträge_, p. 40 (see above, on Judith 1:6).
